overview_description.description: FlatX operates an AI-powered rental marketplace for young and urban renters in India. The company connects tenants directly with verified landlords and existing tenants for flats, rooms, and shared accommodation. Its platform lets users search and filter listings by budget, locality, and flat type, and screen potential flatmates by lifestyle, dietary habits, work schedules, smoking preferences, gender, and pet policies. FlatX runs ID verification and activity checks on users and listings to reduce fake posts and broker interference. The service includes secure in-app messaging so tenants, flatmates, and owners can communicate without sharing personal contact details. By combining structured filters, social matching, and verification, FlatX supports faster discovery of compatible homes and flatmates in dense urban rental markets.
